text.p: Seragen Inc said on Wednesday that its board of directors elected Reed Prior as chairman, chief executive officer and treasurer.
Jean Nichols was elected president, chief technology officer, and a member of the board. Nichols was previously senior vice president.
George Masters, former vice chairman and chief executive officer, is retiring, though he will remain as a consultant to the company, Seragen said.
Also, James Howell is stepping down as chairman and retiring from the board, the company said.
Seragen, a biotechnology concern, said Thomas Konatich was resigning as the company's chief executive officer, effective November 12.
Prior is a specialist in venture-backed companies developing biomedical technologies and products. He was previously chief executive officer of ActiMed Laboratories.
